entry.title: Zero-Copy Region Inference for Asynchronous Rust State Machines
entry.summary:
We formalize a region-based borrow analysis for async/await state machines in Rust that eliminates redundant heap allocations across suspension points. By proving soundness over a core calculus with lifetime projections, our compiler pass reduces generator frame sizes by $38\%$ and improves tail latency by $1.42\times$ on high-concurrency Tokio workloads without unsafe code.

Source: arXiv CS (cs.PL) · Tags: #rust #compilers #performance

entry.title: Byzantine Fault Injection and Split-Brain Recovery in Consensus-Backed Object Stores
entry.summary:
Deterministic simulation testing across five Raft and Paxos storage engines reveals stale reads under asymmetric network partitions coupled with NVMe fsync stalls. We present a formal TLA+ invariant checker that reproduces linearizability violations in under $40\text{ seconds}$ of simulated cluster time.

Source: Jepsen / Distributed Systems · Tags: #distributed-systems #databases #formal-proofs

entry.title: Deterministic B-Tree Compaction Under Serializable Snapshot Isolation. Modern MVCC storage engines suffer from write amplification when long-running read snapshots pin obsolete page versions.
entry.summary:
Modern MVCC storage engines suffer from write amplification when long-running read snapshots pin obsolete page versions. We introduce horizon-partitioned B-epsilon trees that bound worst-case compaction I/O to $O((B \log_B N)/M)$ while preserving strict serializable snapshot isolation across NVMe arrays.

Source: arXiv CS (cs.DB) · Tags: #databases #distributed-systems #algorithms
